title: When Evidence is Sparse: Weakly Supervised Early Failure Alerting in Dialogs and LLM-Agent Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2606.05414v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Early failure alerting requires deciding, while a dialog or agent trajectory unfolds, whether it is likely to fail. Existing approaches broadly follow two directions. LLM-based uncertainty monitoring either elicits confidence from the acting model, tying reliability to its own self-assessment, or queries an external frontier judge at each prefix, incurring costly repeated inference. Trained monitors instead either rely on per-turn annotations, which are rarely available, or train every prefix to predict the terminal outcome without explicitly modeling where failure-indicating evidence appears. We address these limitations with a lightweight external monitor trained only from trajectory-level outcomes, motivated by a pattern across five benchmarks: turns rated highly relevant to failure are sparse and often late. translated_abstract: 早期失败预警需要在对话或智能体轨迹展开的过程中，判断其是否可能失败。现有方法大致遵循两个方向。基于LLM的不确定性监测要么从执行模型自身引出置信度，将可靠性与其自我评估绑定，要么在每个前缀处查询外部的尖端评判模型，导致代价高昂的重复推理。而训练式监测器要么依赖逐轮标注（这种标注很少可得），要么训练每个前缀去预测最终结果，却没有显式建模失败指示证据出现的位置。我们通过一个仅从轨迹级结果训练的轻量级外部监测器来解决这些局限，其动机来自五个基准测试中共同呈现的一种模式：与失败高度相关的轮次既稀疏又往往出现较晚。其基于注意力的多示例学习（MIL）组件从轨迹结果中学习轮次级别的贡献，并且
tldr: 该论文提出一种仅用轨迹级结果标签训练、基于注意力多示例学习（MIL）的轻量级外部监测器，能够在失败指示证据稀疏且出现较晚的情况下，对对话和LLM智能体轨迹实现早期失败预警。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a lightweight external monitor trained solely from trajectory-level outcomes using attention-based multiple instance learning (MIL), enabling early failure alerting in dialogs and LLM-agent trajectories even when failure-indicating evidence is sparse and often appears late.
